title: plantago maritima subsp. juncoides
intro: Plantago maritima subsp. juncoides, commonly known as Irish sea moss, is a subspecies of the plantain family (Plantaginaceae) that thrives in coastal areas. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, supporting immune function, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Irish sea moss are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which work together to calm irritated tissues and modulate immune responses. Additionally, Irish sea moss is rich in vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and dietary supplements.
